title: GTA 6's Mandy Has PS5 Players Smitten: Meet Actress Lexie Shoaibi
description: As millions play GTA 6 on PS5, Chapter 1's Mandy takes social media by storm. Real-life actress Lexie Shoaibi has been revealed as the face of the character.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## A Social Media Sensation on Launch Night

As millions of players dive into the long-awaited launch of *GTA 6*, characters from the opening hours of the game are already leaving a lasting impression. Following the game's overnight release on PlayStation 5, players experiencing Chapter 1's 'Pipeworks' mission quickly took to the internet to share their reactions to one particularly memorable character: Mandy.

Mandy, who wastes no time in throwing herself at Jason during a very early story mission, instantly became a talking point across social media platforms. Gaming media outlets noted that her introduction was bound to make waves, and the community's reaction has certainly lived up to that expectation.

## Meet Real-Life Actress Lexie Shoaibi

With the character taking the web by storm, the talent behind the role has now come to light. Actress Lexie Shoaibi has officially revealed that she stars as Mandy in *GTA 6*.

Shoaibi's portrayal of the bold and lively character has resonated with the millions of players currently exploring the new open world. Her entertaining interaction with Jason in the 'Pipeworks' mission sets a vibrant tone for the early stages of the game's narrative.

## Editor's Take

It is always fascinating to see which characters capture the community's imagination during a major game launch. The overnight success of Mandy and actress Lexie Shoaibi highlights Rockstar's enduring talent for memorable casting, setting a high standard for the rest of the *GTA 6* experience.
